prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 二维合并 · 采购评审 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "甲、乙两家报价接近，建议进入第二轮商务谈判，重点" spans 1 col × 2 row; "未按要求提交完整报价文件，视为无效投标" spans 3 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "供应商" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "报价" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 3: header "交期" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 38px
  col 4: header "质保" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "评审意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 582px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录采购评审中各供应商的报价、交期、质保和评审结论，支持比较及筛选。","reading":"按行查看各供应商的情况，并纵向比较报价、交期和质保；甲、乙两行共用评审意见，丙的无效投标说明横跨三个指标列。","groups":["报价、交期和质保是并列的采购指标，宜保持紧凑且便于纵向比较。","供应商与评审意见分别标识评审对象和结论；甲、乙的合并意见关联两行，应作为共同结论阅读。"],"keep_intact":["供应商名称","报价金额及货币符号","交期和质保数值及单位","列标题"],"may_wrap":["甲、乙两家的长评审意见可自然换行，其合并单元格可利用两行的总高度。","丙的无效投标说明可在横跨的三个指标列内自然换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [70, 115, 90, 85, 359] · table 720×169px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [70, 120, 100, 90, 339] · table 720×169px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"供应商名称、金额、交期和质保均保持完整，表头清晰；甲、乙共用的评审意见分两行，容易与两家供应商对应。","problems":"丙的无效投标说明末尾的“投标”被挤到第二行，形成短尾；三个指标列的空白较多。","cause":"报价、交期和质保列合计290px，横跨单元格的可用文字宽度不足以容纳完整说明。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"各列标题和指标值均完整，三个指标列稍宽，纵向比较从容。","problems":"丙的说明只剩“标”字落在第二行，比r2A更零碎；评审意见也因列宽缩小而在“谈判”中间换行。指标列仍有较多空白。","cause":"三个指标列合计310px，仍略不足以让丙的说明完整排成一行；评审意见列从359px缩至339px，改变了长意见的断行位置。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3-merged-fit","widths":[70,125,105,100,319],"change":"将三个指标列合计增至330px，尝试让丙的无效投标说明完整排成一行；保留足够宽的评审意见列，观察共用意见的断行。"},{"name":"r3-opinion","widths":[70,100,65,60,424],"change":"收紧三个指标列，并保留金额及表头所需宽度，把更多空间分配给共用评审意见；接受丙的说明换行，以改善整表空间分配。"},{"name":"r3-balanced","widths":[70,110,85,80,374],"change":"在r2A基础上略收紧指标列、加宽评审意见，寻求两处长文本更均衡的换行，同时保持指标列便于比较。"}]}
